references.text: Continuation of the law concerning seed: if water falls on the seed and a dead animal falls upon it, it becomes unclean - this expands on the principle from verse 37
Concerns uncleanness through contact with dead bodies, the same theme regarding carrion and impurity
Refers to animals that die of natural causes and how the Israelites were to deal with carcasses
Paul uses the image of seed that must die to receive new life, a spiritual application of the principle of seed and death
